title: Homilies on the Song of Songs, Homilia II
blurb: Origen’s Homilia II on the Song of Songs (Jerome’s Latin). Complete on this page: §§1–13.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Origen’s Homilia II on the Song of Songs — no previous public-domain English (ANF lacks these homilies; Lawson ACW 26 is copyrighted and was not used as wording). This page is Homilia II §§1–13 (closeout). The English here is new.

text_history.method: English follows Baehrens, Origenes Werke VIII (GCS 33, 1925), Jerome’s Latin of Homilia II. Lawson ACW 26 was not used as wording. This page is Homilia II §§1–13 (closeout).
